title: Ekos Device Reconnect Churn
dataSources: NINA sequences (`nina:sequence`), NINA autofocus runs (`nina:autofocus`), Ekos scheduler and device events (`ekos:scheduler`, `ekos:device`), PHD2 guiding telemetry (`phd2:guide`), plate solves (`platesolve:run`), filter wheel events (`filterwheel:event`), and flat frames (`flatlib:frame`).
app: Astrophotography session telemetry from N.I.N.A., KStars/Ekos, PHD2, plate-solving tools, ASCOM gear, and filter-wheel controllers sent to Splunk HEC via logs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ekos:device
| search event="reconnect"
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as reconnects by _time device_type
| sort - _time
description: Tracks Ekos device reconnects over time and breaks it out by device type.
value: Reconnect churn is a simple signal that USB, power, or driver stability is degrading.
implementation: Send Ekos device reconnects events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of Ekos device reconnects by device type.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how Ekos device reconnects changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
